name: Shri Khatu Shyam Ji Temple
also_known_as: Khatu Shyam Mandir, Shyam Baba Temple, Khatu Naresh
deity: Khatu Shyam Ji, worshipped by devotees as a form of Krishna/Shyam
about: Khatu Shyam Ji Temple is located in the village of Khatu in Rajasthan's Sikar district. The shrine is dedicated to Khatu Shyam Ji, who is worshipped by devotees as the manifestation of Barbarika, a figure associated with the Mahabharata.
image_keywords: Khatu Shyam Ji Temple temple architecture

name: Shri Salasar Balaji Temple
deity: Lord Hanuman, worshipped here as Balaji
about: Salasar Balaji Temple is a major Hindu pilgrimage site dedicated to Lord Hanuman. It is located in the town of Salasar in Churu district, Rajasthan, and is also commonly known as Salasar Dham. The temple attracts devotees throughout the year and receives particularly large crowds during Chaitra Purnima and Ashvin/Sharad Purnima. (Rajasthan Tourism)
how_to_reach: By Road: Salasar is located near Sujangarh in Churu district and is connected by road. The Rajasthan Government places Salasar approximately 25 km from Sujangarh and approximately 170 km from Jaipur. name: Shri Govind Dev Ji Temple
also_known_as: Govind Devji Mandir, Govind Dev Ji Temple
deity: Lord Krishna in the form of Govind Dev Ji, worshipped along with Radha
about: Govind Dev Ji Temple is one of Jaipur's most important Krishna temples. It is located within the City Palace complex area, between Chandra Mahal and Badal Mahal, in the Jainiwas Garden. The temple is dedicated to Govind Dev Ji, a form of Lord Krishna, and is deeply associated with the former Kachwaha royal family of Jaipur. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in)
how_to_reach: By Road: The temple is located in the Jainiwas Garden area near Jalebi Chowk and the City Palace complex in central Jaipur.  By Train: Jaipur Junction Railway Station is approximately 5 km from the temple according to the Rajasthan Government's Devasthan Department. (devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in)  By Air: Jaipur International Airport at Sanganer is approximately 14 km from the temple according to the Rajasthan Government's Devasthan Department. name: Shri Shrinathji Temple
deity: Lord Shrinathji, a form of Lord Krishna
category: Hindu Temple / Krishna Temple / Pilgrimage Site
about: Shrinathji Temple is a major Vaishnava pilgrimage site located in Nathdwara, Rajsamand district, Rajasthan. The temple is dedicated to Shrinathji, a form of Lord Krishna depicted as a seven-year-old child lifting Govardhan Hill with his left hand. Nathdwara is located on the banks of the Banas River and is widely known for its association with the Shrinathji temple and Pushtimarg tradition. (incredibleindia.gov.in)
how_to_reach: By Air: The nearest airport listed by the Rajasthan Government's Devasthan Department is Maharana Pratap Airport, Udaipur, approximately 50 km from Nathdwara. name: Ranakpur Jain Temple
also_known_as: Ranakpur Jain Temples, Ranakpur Jain Temple Complex
about: Ranakpur Jain Temple is one of the most important Jain pilgrimage sites in Rajasthan. It is located in the Aravalli hills of Pali district and is known for its extensive marble construction and highly detailed stone carvings.
how_to_reach: By Road: Ranakpur is connected by road with Udaipur, Pali, Jodhpur and other parts of Rajasthan.  From Udaipur: Ranakpur is approximately 90 km from Udaipur. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in)  By Train: Falna Railway Station is generally used by visitors travelling to Ranakpur by rail. From Falna, visitors can continue by road.  By Air: The nearest major airport is Maharana Pratap Airport in Udaipur. Visitors can continue from Udaipur to Ranakpur by road.

name: Ajmer Sharif Dargah
about: Ajmer Sharif Dargah is the shrine of the renowned Sufi saint Khwaja Moinuddin Hasan Chishti, popularly known as Khwaja Gharib Nawaz. It is located in the heart of Ajmer and is one of India's most important Sufi pilgrimage destinations. The shrine attracts devotees from different parts of India and abroad and is visited by people of different faiths. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in
how_to_reach: By Road: Ajmer is well connected by road with Jaipur, Delhi, Jodhpur and other major cities of Rajasthan. The Dargah is located in central Ajmer and can be reached by local auto-rickshaw, cycle-rickshaw, tonga and local buses. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in  By Train: Ajmer Junction Railway Station is the principal railway station serving the city and is the most convenient railway station for visitors travelling to the Dargah. name: Shri Karni Mata Temple
also_known_as: Karni Mata Mandir, Deshnok Karni Mata Temple, Rat Temple
about: Karni Mata Temple is a famous Hindu temple located in Deshnok, near Bikaner in Rajasthan. The temple is dedicated to Karni Mata, a Hindu female saint and revered figure associated with the Charan community.
how_to_reach: By Road: Deshnok is approximately 30–35 km from Bikaner and is connected to Bikaner by road. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in  By Train: Deshnok Railway Station serves the town. The Rajasthan Government identifies it as the nearby railway station, although it does not provide a current distance figure. (devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in  By Air: Nal Airport, Bikaner, is approximately 31 km from the temple according to the Rajasthan Government's Devasthan Department. name: Dilwara Jain Temples
display_title: Dilwara Jain Temples, Mount Abu, Rajasthan
category: Jain Temple Complex / Religious & Architectural Heritage Site
about: The Dilwara Jain Temples are a group of five historic Jain temples located near Mount Abu in Rajasthan. They are renowned for their exceptionally detailed white-marble carvings, ornate ceilings, pillars, domes and decorative stonework. The temples were constructed between the 11th and 16th centuries and are considered among the finest examples of Jain temple architecture in India. (incredibleindia.gov.in
how_to_reach: By Road: Mount Abu is connected by road with Udaipur, Ahmedabad, Jaipur and other cities.  By Train: Abu Road Railway Station is approximately 28 km from Mount Abu. (incredibleindia.gov.in  By Air: Maharana Pratap Airport, Udaipur, is approximately 176 km from Mount Abu. (incredibleindia.gov.in
nearby_places: Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station and is situated in the Aravalli Range.

name: Shri Sanwaliya Seth Temple
also_known_as: Sanwaliya Ji Temple, Sanwaliya Seth Dham, Sanwariya Seth Temple
deity: Lord Krishna, worshipped as Sanwaliya Seth
category: Hindu Temple / Krishna Temple / Pilgrimage Site
about: Sanwaliya Seth Temple is a major Krishna pilgrimage centre located in Mandfiya village in Chittorgarh district, on the Chittorgarh–Udaipur Highway.
how_to_reach: By Road: The temple is located on the Chittorgarh–Udaipur Highway in Mandfiya village. (tourism.rajasthan.gov.in  By Train: Chittorgarh Junction is the main railway station serving the region. Visitors can continue to Mandfiya by road.  By Air: Maharana Pratap Airport in Udaipur is the nearest major airport for visitors arriving by air.

name: Badrinath Temple
category: Hindu Temple / Pilgrimage Site / Char Dham
about: Badrinath Temple, also known as Badrinarayan Temple, is one of the most important Hindu pilgrimage sites in India. It is dedicated to Lord Vishnu and is located in the Himalayan town of Badrinath in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand.
how_to_reach: By Road: Badrinath is connected by road with Rishikesh, Haridwar, Joshimath and other parts of Uttarakhand.  By Train: Rishikesh is the nearest major railway station for visitors travelling towards Badrinath. From there, the journey continues by road.  By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun is the nearest major airport.  Because Himalayan travel conditions can change, road status should be checked immediately before travelling.

name: Kedarnath Temple
category: Hindu Temple / Jyotirlinga / Char Dham / Panch Kedar
about: Kedarnath Temple is one of India's most revered Hindu pilgrimage sites and is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
how_to_reach: By Road: The motorable road ends at Gaurikund for the traditional pilgrimage route. From Gaurikund, pilgrims continue towards Kedarnath on foot or through authorised available transport options.  By Trek: Uttarakhand Tourism currently describes the trek from Gaurikund to Kedarnath as approximately 16 km, while the Panch Kedar tourism page gives approximately 19 km. name: Gangotri
about: Gangotri is a sacred Himalayan pilgrimage town in Uttarkashi district, Uttarakhand. The town is centred around the Gangotri Temple, which is dedicated to Goddess Ganga.
how_to_reach: By Road: Gangotri is connected by motorable roads with major destinations of Uttarakhand.  By Train: Rishikesh is approximately 230 km from Gangotri and is the nearest railway station listed by Uttarakhand Tourism.  By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun, is approximately 250 km from Gangotri. (Uttarakhand Tourism)

name: Yamunotri
about: Yamunotri is one of the four Char Dham pilgrimage destinations of Uttarakhand. The pilgrimage site is centred around Yamunotri Temple, which is dedicated to Goddess Yamuna.
how_to_reach: By Road: Motorable roads reach Janki Chatti, from where the pilgrimage continues on foot or by authorised local options.  By Train: Rishikesh and Haridwar are the main railway points used for travelling towards Yamunotri.  By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun, is the nearest major airport. (Uttarakhand Tourism)
nearby_places: Yamunotri is located at high altitude and involves a steep mountain journey.

name: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple
display_title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
also_known_as: Kashi Vishwanath Mandir, Golden Temple of Varanasi
about: Kashi Vishwanath Temple is one of the most revered Hindu temples in India and is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
how_to_reach: By Air: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport serves Varanasi.  By Train: Varanasi Junction and other railway stations serve the city.  By Road: Varanasi is connected by road with major cities in Uttar Pradesh and neighbouring states.  The temple is situated in the old city, where many lanes are narrow and vehicle access is restricted.

name: Prayagraj
about: Prayagraj is one of India's major Hindu pilgrimage cities and is located at the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna and traditionally believed Saraswati rivers.
how_to_reach: By Air: Prayagraj Airport serves the city.  By Train: Prayagraj Junction and other railway stations provide rail connectivity.  By Road: Prayagraj is connected by road with major cities of Uttar Pradesh and northern India.

name: Haridwar
also_known_as: Haridwar Dham, Gateway to the Gods
about: Haridwar is one of India's most important Hindu pilgrimage cities. It is situated at the foothills of the Himalayas where the River Ganga enters the Indo-Gangetic plains.
how_to_reach: By Air: Jolly Grant Airport near Dehradun is approximately 37 km from Haridwar.  By Train: Haridwar Railway Station is a major railway station with connections to many parts of India.  By Road: Haridwar is well connected by road with Delhi, Dehradun, Rishikesh and other northern Indian cities. (Uttarakhand Tourism)

name: Rishikesh
category: Hindu Pilgrimage City / Spiritual Destination / Yoga Destination
about: Rishikesh is a major spiritual and pilgrimage destination situated on the banks of the River Ganga in the Himalayan foothills.
how_to_reach: By Air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun, is the nearest major airport.  By Train: Rishikesh has a railway station, while Haridwar Junction provides broader railway connectivity.  By Road: Rishikesh is well connected by road with Haridwar, Dehradun, Delhi and other northern Indian cities.

name: Ayodhya
about: Ayodhya is an ancient Hindu pilgrimage city situated on the banks of the River Sarayu in Uttar Pradesh.
how_to_reach: By Air: Maharishi Valmiki International Airport, Ayodhya Dham, serves Ayodhya.  By Train: Ayodhya Dham Junction and Ayodhya Cantt railway stations serve the city.  By Road: Ayodhya is connected by road with Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj and other major cities of Uttar Pradesh.

name: Mathura
about: Mathura is an ancient city in Uttar Pradesh and is traditionally regarded as the birthplace of Lord Krishna.
how_to_reach: By Air: Kheria Airport in Agra is approximately 46 km from Mathura. Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi is approximately 136 km away. (Mathura District)  By Train: Mathura Junction is the principal railway station serving the city. Mathura Cantt is another railway station. (Mathura District)  By Road: Mathura is well connected by road with Delhi, Agra and other major cities.

name: Vrindavan
about: Vrindavan is one of the most important pilgrimage destinations associated with Lord Krishna and Radha. It is located in Mathura district and forms an important part of the Braj Bhoomi pilgrimage region.
how_to_reach: By Air: Agra Airport is the nearest major airport, while Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport provides wider connectivity.  By Train: Mathura Junction is the major railway station serving Vrindavan and is approximately 11 km away.  By Road: Vrindavan is connected by road with Mathura, Agra, Delhi and other cities in Uttar Pradesh.

name: Dwarka
category: Hindu Pilgrimage City / Char Dham / Krishna Pilgrimage Site
about: Dwarka is an ancient Hindu pilgrimage city on the western coast of Gujarat. It is traditionally associated with Lord Krishna and is one of India's four major Char Dham pilgrimage destinations.
how_to_reach: By Air: Jamnagar Airport is the nearest major airport.  By Train: Dwarka Railway Station connects the city with major Indian destinations.  By Road: Dwarka is connected by road with Jamnagar, Rajkot, Ahmedabad and other cities of Gujarat.

name: Shri Jagannath Temple
category: Hindu Temple / Char Dham / Pilgrimage Site
about: The Jagannath Temple is one of the most important Hindu temples in India and is located in the coastal pilgrimage city of Puri.
how_to_reach: By Air: Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar is the nearest major airport.  By Train: Puri Railway Station provides direct rail connectivity with major Indian cities.  By Road: Puri is well connected with Bhubaneswar, Cuttack and other cities in Odisha.

name: Rameshwaram
about: Rameshwaram is one of India's most important Hindu pilgrimage destinations. It is located on Rameshwaram Island in Tamil Nadu.
how_to_reach: By Air: Madurai Airport is approximately 175 km from Rameshwaram.  By Train: Rameshwaram has its own railway station, approximately 1.3 km from Ramanathaswamy Temple. (ramanathapuram.nic.in  By Road: Rameshwaram is connected by road with Madurai, Ramanathapuram and other cities in Tamil Nadu.

name: Sri Venkateswara Temple
about: The Sri Venkateswara Temple is located at Tirumala, above the city of Tirupati in Andhra Pradesh.
how_to_reach: By Air: Tirupati Airport serves the city.  By Train: Tirupati Railway Station is the main railway station.  By Road: Tirupati and Tirumala are connected by road with major cities in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

name: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine
about: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine is one of India's most visited Hindu pilgrimage destinations.
how_to_reach: By Air: Jammu Airport is the main airport used by pilgrims travelling to Katra.  By Train: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra Railway Station provides direct rail connectivity.  By Road: Katra is connected by road with Jammu and other cities of northern India.

name: Shirdi
about: Shirdi is a major pilgrimage destination in Maharashtra associated with Sai Baba of Shirdi.
how_to_reach: By Air: Shirdi Airport provides air connectivity.  By Train: Sainagar Shirdi Railway Station serves the town.  By Road: Shirdi is connected by road with Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Aurangabad and other cities in Maharashtra.

name: Shree Somnath Temple
about: Somnath Temple is one of the most important Shiva temples in India and is traditionally regarded as the first among the twelve Jyotirlingas.
how_to_reach: By Air: Diu Airport is the nearest airport.  By Train: Veraval Railway Station is the nearest major railway station.  By Road: Somnath is connected by road with Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Dwarka and other destinations in Gujarat.

name: Shri Mahakaleshwar Temple
about: Mahakaleshwar Temple is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva and is located in the ancient city of Ujjain.
how_to_reach: By Air: Devi Ahilyabai Holkar Airport, Indore, is approximately 53 km away.  By Train: Ujjain Railway Station has connections with major Indian cities.  By Road: Ujjain is connected by road with Indore, Bhopal, Ratlam and other cities. (ujjain.nic.in

name: Sri Harmandir Sahib
about: Sri Harmandir Sahib, commonly known as the Golden Temple, is the central religious place of Sikhism and is located in Amritsar, Punjab.
how_to_reach: By Air: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport is approximately 13 km from the Golden Temple.  By Train: Amritsar Railway Station is approximately 2 km away.  By Road: Amritsar is well connected by road with Delhi, Chandigarh, Jammu and other cities. (amritsar.nic.in

name: Konark Sun Temple
category: Hindu Temple / Monument / UNESCO World Heritage Site
about: The Konark Sun Temple is a historic temple dedicated to Surya, the Sun God.
how_to_reach: By Air: Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar is the nearest major airport.  By Train: Puri Railway Station is the nearest major railway station commonly used by visitors.  By Road: Konark is connected by road with Puri and Bhubaneswar.
